pageDescription: Automate scans, cleanups, and updates on a schedule
emptyStateDescription: Create a schedule to automatically run scans, cleanups, and updates.
failedEnableStartup: Failed to enable startup. Schedules may not run after reboot.
deleteConfirmDescription: This schedule will be permanently removed. This action cannot be undone.

presets.weeklyFullCleanDescription: All cleaner categories every Monday at 9 AM
presets.dailyLightSweepDescription: System, browsers & recycle bin daily at 8 AM
presets.monthlyDeepMaintenanceDescription: Full clean + registry, drivers & software on the 1st at 10 AM
presets.customDescription: Start from scratch with a blank schedule

dialog.autoApplyDescription: Automatically clean files, fix registry issues, and install updates without confirmation.
dialog.autoApplyWarning: Actions will run automatically on schedule. Make sure your exclusions list is up to date.

advanced.title: Run conditions
advanced.explanation: All conditions are checked before a run starts. Between tasks, power, idle time and Game Mode are checked again; the maintenance window and free-space threshold only gate the start, so a workflow that begins inside the window or below the threshold finishes its remaining tasks. Times follow this computer's local time zone. Running operations finish before a changed condition stops the remaining tasks.
advanced.gameMode: Wait while Game Mode is active or restoring
advanced.disk: Only when the home drive is low on space
advanced.missed: If the scheduled time is missed or conditions are not ready
advanced.skip: Skip after the two-minute start window
advanced.once: Run once when ready; combine missed runs
advanced.runConfirm: Run this schedule now using its saved tasks and auto-apply choice? Its power, idle, Game Mode, space and maintenance-window conditions still apply: a run they hold back starts at a later check, and choosing Run now again while it is waiting cancels it.
advanced.workflowHint: Tasks run from top to bottom. A category restriction applies only to future matching scan results. Recycle Bin remains a whole-bin operation.
advanced.scopeHint: Only checked categories will be included. An empty selection runs no cleanup in this task. Scan discovers categories currently present; it does not clean.
advanced.waitForScan: Wait for the current scan or cleanup to finish.
advanced.noCategories: No categories found. Run a new scan when the application has cached data.

waiting.game-mode: Waiting for Game Mode to finish
waiting.changed: Schedule was edited; queued definition discarded
waiting.interrupted: The run lost its window and was recorded as failed; this occurrence will not replay.

advanced.saveFailed: The schedule could not be saved. Try again.
